name: env_manager
description: Manage environment variables. Read, set, and list env vars. Also parse and edit .env files.

manual.overview: Use to read or list environment variables and parse .env files when configuring apps, debugging config issues, or checking runtime context.

examples.description: Retrieve a specific env var (e.g., PATH, API_KEY)
Read and parse a .env file from a custom path

tips: Use get for specific keys; list can be noisy and expose secrets in logs
Specify path for read_dotenv when project uses .env.local or .env.production
Do not log or echo raw env values that may contain secrets
edge_cases: Some vars are shell-only and not visible to child processes
Reading .env does not apply values—it only returns file contents

executor.command: python -c "import os, json; action='{{args.action}}'; key='{{args.key}}'; path='{{args.path}}'; r=os.environ.get(key,'not set') if action=='get' else json.dumps(dict(os.environ),indent=2) if action=='list' else open(path).read(); print(r)"
